newsitem.title: DENMARK: Danish rally dies, market seen flat to falling.
newsitem.headline: Danish rally dies, market seen flat to falling.

text.p: An early rally in Danish share prices ran out of steam during Wednesday, exacerbated by a 3.5 percent fall in Danisco. Dealers expected prices to tread water for the rest of the week although further falls were seen as possible.
"The market is a bit flat at the moment although I shouldn't be surprised if the index fell one percent during the rest of the week," a dealer said.
The KFX top-20 index fell 0.28 point to 172.00, in overall bourse turnover of 1.9 billion crowns, after earlier rising to 172.80.
The KFX August future was untraded at 172.60.
Danisco fell to 414.00 crowns from Tuesday's 429.00 after publishing annual results which showed a 14 percent rise in profits but warned of lower growth next year.
Novo Nordisk saw brisk turnover of 273,000 shares traded and rose two crowns to 725.00 although dealers were unaware of any news on the drug company.
A long-awaited government announcement that it planned to sell off all or part of its remaining 52 percent stake in Tele Danmark had little effect. The share fell two crowns to 343.00.
